title: Front wheel play & steering looseness
vehicle_scope: BMW E30 325iX sedan, original 1987-12 Swiss/ECE; vehicle-specific configuration still requires inspection
purpose: Document and narrow an observed play/looseness complaint, not diagnose it remotely or authorize repair.
warning: Steering and front-axle movement may be safety-critical. Do not drive if instability, abnormal looseness, binding or component damage is suspected. Lifting, wheel-play checks and suspension loading require a trained professional and appropriate equipment; do not improvise methods.

sources.title: BMW AG TIS — Aid to Diagnosing the Steering System
sources.status: SOURCE_PAGE_READ; GENERIC SERVICE-INFORMATION CONTENT; E30 iX PAGE INDEX DOES NOT VERIFY EVERY LISTED CONFIGURATION
sources.summary: Source lists steering-column behavior and inspection of suspension/steering joints, strut mount, steering-shaft joints, track rods and rubber mounts for wear or play. It also refers to separate BMW repair procedures.

sources.title: BMW AG TIS — Test Conditions for Chassis/Wheel Alignment
sources.status: SOURCE_PAGE_READ; PRECONDITIONS ONLY; NOT AN ALIGNMENT OR REPAIR PROCEDURE
sources.summary: Before alignment the source requires appropriate wheels/tyres/pressure and acceptable wheel-bearing clearance, steering backlash, suspension and shock absorber condition.

steps.title: 1. Describe the symptom
steps.purpose: Write what was actually noticed before diagnosing its cause.
steps.prompt: Which wheel/corner, when does play occur, what changed, and is the car currently being driven?
steps.evidence: Owner description, date, side and operating condition.

steps.title: 2. Find the correct iX assembly
steps.purpose: Match the suspected area to the E30 325iX catalog drawing; a catalog row is not VIN-fitment proof.
steps.prompt: Open the relevant exploded assembly; record catalog callout and stamped or measured identifiers of the actual installed component.
steps.evidence: Assembly ID, part markings, original catalog link and photo ID.

steps.title: 3. Photograph the actual hardware
steps.purpose: Distinguish the car’s physical parts from vendor catalog images and exploded schematics.
steps.prompt: Add overall and close-up images where safely accessible; capture boots, joints, mounts and part numbers without dismantling.
steps.evidence: Workshop photograph filename, person, timestamp, source; supplier images labeled separately.

steps.title: 4. Qualified steering/front-axle inspection
steps.purpose: Record a trained mechanic’s inspection findings on steering joints, wheel bearings, strut mounts and suspension connections.
steps.prompt: Ask a qualified mechanic to identify the location of play or binding using suitable equipment and the applicable BMW method. Do not perform unsupervised lifting or joint-loading tests.
steps.evidence: Component inspected, physical finding, mechanic, source/procedure and any unresolved safety concern.

steps.title: 5. Preserve actual measurements
steps.purpose: Avoid judging wear or tolerances from unsourced values or photos alone.
steps.prompt: Record numeric measurements with unit, tool/calibration, conditions and the relevant original BMW reference. Missing limits remain unknown.
steps.evidence: Measured values, unit, tool, responsible person and BMW source; do not fill guessed tolerances.

steps.title: 6. Evaluate repair before replacement
steps.purpose: Prefer rebuilding existing OEM parts where practicable and safe; compare sourced alternatives only after fitment and material verification.
steps.prompt: Document repairability, cost and technical implications of rebuild, used/refurbished OEM, specification-verified cross-fit, and new parts. Do not choose without evidence.
steps.evidence: Candidate part numbers, verified dimensions/supplier sources, condition, estimated costs and unresolved constraints.

steps.title: 7. Review, export and safety hold
steps.purpose: Reopen the saved job, review missing evidence and export the record. The software never grants road-use approval.
steps.prompt: Confirm an independent qualified review is still required. Record the reviewer and final test evidence once physically available; unresolved items remain open.
steps.evidence: Reviewer name/role, outstanding source pages and open issues.
